# #154 Sign up as a coach with an owner invite code
## Parent
#153
## What to build
The owner can invite a new coach before the account exists: issuing a coach invite in "new account" mode holds a username and prints a single-use code. The future coach signs up with that username and the code, which they reveal via an "I have a coach invite code" link on the sign-up screen. The account is created already able to coach, and after the recovery-email gate they land in Coach mode on Roster, with no lifter intake. Decisions: spec #153 (Q1, Q4–Q10).
## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Issuing with the new-account flag holds the username and prints the code once (hash-only storage). Lifetime: default 24 h, maximum 7 days, minimum 5 minutes as today. It refuses a username that belongs to a live account, or one held by another live new-account invite. Without the flag, issuing behaves exactly as today. - [ ] While the hold is live, registering that username without the matching code is refused with the same generic "username unavailable" response as a taken username. After expiry the username is free. - [ ] Registration accepts an optional coach invite code. A valid code for exactly that held username creates the account, grants the coach capability, and marks the invite used, all in one catalog transaction. Any mismatch (wrong, expired, used, different username, or an account-bound code) fails with one generic message, "This coach invite code isn't valid for this username", and creates nothing. - [ ] Sign-up screen: an "I have a coach invite code" link, styled like the other auth links, reveals an optional code field that can be cleared or hidden again. A valid code leads through the recovery-email gate into Coach mode on Roster. An invalid code shows the error. - [ ] Accounts created this way are ordinary coach accounts. Existing capability, deletion and disable rules apply unchanged, and Player mode offers "Set up your own training". - [ ] New ADR 050, "Coach invites can create the account", amending the owner-invite rule. A "Coach invite" glossary entry in `CONTEXT.md` that distinguishes it from the assignment invite. The deployment and authentication docs describe the flag and flow. - [ ] Tests: - Backend, through the HTTP API and the issue function: issuing refusals and bounds; valid-code registration yielding coach capability; every invalid-code case creating nothing; hold refusal and expiry; the existing account-bound flow unchanged. - Mobile widget tests through the real app with the fake API: the link reveals the field, a valid code lands in Coach mode after the gate, and an invalid code shows the error.
## Blocked by
None (can start immediately).
